venues.parkingDetail: Pay parking is available on 6th St. Other lots within a 2 block radius. venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: The wheelchair/accessible seats are on the outside aisle of sections A and D on the main floor and row HH in the same sections. It is always seat 1 in section A and the higher numbered seat in section D on the outside aisle. These are theatre seats and must be unbolted and removed for a wheelchair. Accessible aisle seat is the even X-number, the companion is the odd X-number. If you are selling into an account, please indicate in the Extra line to keep or remove the seat. Row HH is 6 moveable, padded chairs and a wheelchair can sit anywhere along the row.
